name: coherence_bound
statement:
theorem coherence_bound
    {n₀ k : ℕ}
    (Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hQTQ : Q₀.transpose * Q₀ = 1)
    (H_star : ℝ)
    (h_ratio : (↑n₀ : ℝ) / (↑k : ℝ) < H_star)
    (hk_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (↑k : ℝ))
    [Nonempty (Fin n₀)] :
    mu Q₀ < H_star
proof:
:= by
  have hP_proj : Q₀ * Q₀.transpose * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) = Q₀ * Q₀.transpose := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q₀.transpose Q₀ Q₀.transpose]
    rw [hQTQ, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hP_symm_entry : ∀ a b : Fin n₀, (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) a b = (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) b a := by
    intro a b
    have hP_symm : (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose).transpose = Q₀ * Q₀.transpose := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    have := congr_fun (congr_fun hP_symm b) a
    rwa [Matrix.transpose_apply] at this
  have h_row_bound : ∀ i : Fin n₀, ∑ j : Fin k, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    have hP_ii : (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i = ∑ j, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 := by
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, sq]
    have hPP_diag : ∑ k, ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k) ^ 2 = (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i := by
      have h1 : ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose)) i i =
          ∑ k, (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) k i := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
      have h2 : ∑ k, (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) k i =
          ∑ k, ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k) ^ 2 := by
        congr 1; ext k; rw [sq, hP_symm_entry k i]
      linarith [congr_fun (congr_fun hP_proj i) i, h1, h2]
    have hPii_sq_le : (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k, ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [← hP_ii]
    nlinarith [hPP_diag, hPii_sq_le, sq_nonneg ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i - 1)]
  have h_sup_le : ⨆ i : Fin n₀, ∑ j : Fin k, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 ≤ 1 :=
    ciSup_le h_row_bound
  have h_mu_le : mu Q₀ ≤ (↑n₀ : ℝ) / (↑k : ℝ) := by
    unfold mu
    calc (↑n₀ / ↑k : ℝ) * (⨆ i, ∑ j, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2)
        ≤ (↑n₀ / ↑k : ℝ) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sup_le (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hk_pos))
      _ = ↑n₀ / ↑k := mul_one _
  linarith

lemma Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : n > 0) : n - 1 < n := by
  cases n with
  | zero => linarith
  | succ n => simp

inductive ColIndex (m H J : ℕ)
  | selected (q : Fin m)
  | finalSelected
  | cross (i : Fin 2)
  | frame (h : Fin H)
  | residual (j : Fin J)

deriving Fintype, DecidableEq

structure GlobalParams where
  H_star : ℝ
  hH_star : H_star > 1
  B : ℝ
  hB : B > 0
  e : ℝ
  he : e ≥ 0
  K : ℕ
  hK : K ≥ 1
  eta : ℝ
  heta_pos : eta > 0
  heta_bound : Real.exp (2 * eta) < H_star
  m : ℕ
  hm : m > 0
  hk : m + 1 ≥ K
  alpha : ℝ
  halpha : alpha > 0
  sigma : Fin m → ℝ
  hsigma : ∀ t, sigma t = 1 ∨ sigma t = -1

namespace GlobalParams

noncomputable def epsilon (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-p.eta / (p.m + 1))

noncomputable def d (p : GlobalParams) (t : Fin p.m) : ℝ :=
  p.alpha * p.epsilon ^ t.1

noncomputable def s (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (1 - p.epsilon ^ 2)

noncomputable def d_m (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  p.d ⟨p.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos p.hm⟩

noncomputable def r (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  let tau_0 := 1 / 16
  tau_0 * p.d_m ^ 2

noncomputable def beta : ℝ := 1 / 2
noncomputable def gamma_0 : ℝ := 1 / 4
noncomputable def tau_0 : ℝ := 1 / 16
noncomputable def delta_res : ℝ := 1 / 2

noncomputable def R_beta (p : GlobalParams) : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ :=
  fun t q =>
    if t = q then p.d t
    else if t.1 < q.1 then
      -beta * p.sigma t * p.sigma q * p.s * p.d t
    else 0

noncomputable def z (p : GlobalParams) : Fin p.m → ℝ :=
  fun t =>
    if t.1 < p.m - 1 then
      gamma_0 * p.sigma t * p.s * p.d t
    else
      gamma_0 * p.sigma t * Real.sqrt (1 - tau_0) * p.d t

noncomputable def eta_p (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt tau_0 * p.d_m

noncomputable def kappa_z : ℝ := 1 + (3 / 5) ^ 2 + (4 / 5) ^ 2

noncomputable def kappa_eta : ℝ := 1 + (7 / 15) ^ 2 + (9 / 10) ^ 2

noncomputable def M_rem (p : GlobalParams) : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ :=
  (1 : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ) - p.R_beta * p.R_beta.transpose
    - kappa_z • Matrix.vecMulVec p.z p.z

noncomputable def a_pq (p : GlobalParams) (q : Fin p.m) : Fin (p.m + 1) → ℝ :=
  fun i =>
    if h : i.1 < p.m then p.R_beta (Fin.castLT i h) q
    else 0

noncomputable def a_p (p : GlobalParams) : Fin (p.m + 1) → ℝ :=
  fun i =>
    if h : i.1 < p.m then p.z (Fin.castLT i h)
    else p.eta_p

noncomputable def a_cross (p : GlobalParams) (idx : Fin 2) : Fin (p.m + 1) → ℝ :=
  let a := ![3 / 5, 4 / 5]
  let b := ![7 / 15, 9 / 10]
  fun i =>
    if h : i.1 < p.m then a idx * p.z (Fin.castLT i h)
    else -b idx * p.eta_p

noncomputable def R_plus (p : GlobalParams) :
    Matrix (Fin (p.m + 1)) (Fin (p.m + 1)) ℝ :=
  fun i j =>
    if h_i : i.1 < p.m then
      if h_j : j.1 < p.m then
        p.R_beta (Fin.castLT i h_i) (Fin.castLT j h_j)
      else
        p.z (Fin.castLT i h_i)
    else
      if _ : j.1 < p.m then 0
      else p.eta_p

end GlobalParams

structure Decomposition (p : GlobalParams) where
  H : ℕ
  W : Fin H → ℝ
  u : Fin H → (Fin p.m → ℝ)
  hW_pos : ∀ h, W h > 0
  hunit : ∀ h, ∑ i : Fin p.m, u h i ^ 2 = 1
  hdecomp : ∀ i j : Fin p.m,
    p.M_rem i j = ∑ h : Fin H, W h * u h i * u h j
  hW_bound : ∀ h, W h < p.d_m ^ 2

structure ResidualParams (p : GlobalParams) (d : Decomposition p) where
  J : ℕ
  theta : Fin J → ℝ
  htheta_pos : ∀ j, theta j > 0
  htheta_lt_cres : ∀ j, theta j < p.r / 2
  hmu_res_pos : 1 - GlobalParams.kappa_eta * p.r > 0
  hsum_theta : ∑ j : Fin J, theta j = 1 - GlobalParams.kappa_eta * p.r

open GlobalParams

noncomputable def A (p : GlobalParams)
    (d : Decomposition p)
    (rp : ResidualParams p d)
    : Matrix (Fin (p.m + 1)) (ColIndex p.m d.H rp.J) ℝ :=
  fun i idx => match idx with
    | ColIndex.selected q =>
        p.a_pq q i
    | ColIndex.finalSelected =>
        p.a_p i
    | ColIndex.cross idx =>
        p.a_cross idx i
    | ColIndex.frame h =>
        if h' : i.1 < p.m then
          Real.sqrt (d.W h) * d.u h (Fin.castLT i h')
        else 0
    | ColIndex.residual j =>
        if _ : i.1 < p.m then 0
        else Real.sqrt (rp.theta j)

noncomputable def Q (p : GlobalParams)
    (d : Decomposition p)
    (rp : ResidualParams p d)
    : Matrix (ColIndex p.m d.H rp.J) (Fin (p.m + 1)) ℝ :=
  (A p d rp).transpose

def colIndexEquiv (m H J : ℕ) :
    ColIndex m H J ≃ (Fin m) ⊕ (Unit) ⊕ (Fin 2) ⊕ (Fin H) ⊕ (Fin J) where
  toFun c := match c with
    | .selected q => .inl q
    | .finalSelected => .inr (.inl ())
    | .cross i => .inr (.inr (.inl i))
    | .frame h => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl h)))
    | .residual j => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr j)))
  invFun s := match s with
    | .inl q => .selected q
    | .inr (.inl ()) => .finalSelected
    | .inr (.inr (.inl i)) => .cross i
    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl h))) => .frame h
    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr j))) => .residual j
  left_inv c := by cases c <;> rfl
  right_inv s := by rcases s with q | ⟨⟩ | i | h | j <;> rfl

statement:
theorem gamma_source_scale_violation
    (gp : GlobalParams)
    (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp)
    (B e : ℝ) (hB : B > 0) (_he : e ≥ 0)
    (_hB_eq : gp.B = B) (_he_eq : gp.e = e)
    (m : ℕ) (_hm_eq : gp.m = m) (_hm_pos : m > 0)
    (h_denom_pos : (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) *
        ((↑(Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)) : ℝ) - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1) > 0)
    (h_inv_R : Invertible gp.R_beta)
    (h_bsns_large : QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r >
        (B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 *
          ((↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) *
           ((↑(Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)) : ℝ) - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1))) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let n₀ := Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    let pivots₀ : Fin (gp.m + 1) → Fin n₀ := fun t =>
      if h : t.val < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, h⟩)
      else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected
    (hInv_inst : Invertible (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)) →
    gamma Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst / Real.sqrt (↑(gp.m + 1) * (↑n₀ - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1)) > B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e := by
  intro eidx n₀ Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst
  have h_alpha_pos := gp.halpha
  have h_inv_block : Invertible (QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedBlock gp.R_beta gp.z gp.eta_p) := by
    apply Matrix.invertibleOfIsUnitDet
    rw [QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.sb_eq, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · haveI := h_inv_R
      exact ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (isUnit_of_invertible gp.R_beta)).ne_zero
    · rw [Matrix.det_fin_one]
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
      simp only [GlobalParams.eta_p, GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d, GlobalParams.epsilon,
        GlobalParams.tau_0]
      exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num))
        (mul_pos h_alpha_pos (pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _)))
  have h_r_eq : gp.r = gp.eta_p ^ 2 := by
    change GlobalParams.tau_0 * gp.d_m ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt GlobalParams.tau_0 * gp.d_m) ^ 2
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ GlobalParams.tau_0 by
      unfold GlobalParams.tau_0; norm_num)]
  have h_r_pos : gp.r > 0 := by
    simp only [GlobalParams.r, GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d, GlobalParams.epsilon]
    exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (sq_pos_of_pos (mul_pos h_alpha_pos (pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _)))
  have h_L4 := QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.lemma4_selected_block_pressure
    gp.R_beta gp.z gp.eta_p gp.r h_r_eq h_r_pos h_inv_R h_inv_block
  set L4sel := QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix gp.R_beta gp.z gp.eta_p with hL4sel_def
  have h_matrix_eq : selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀ =
      L4sel.submatrix (⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) (⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) := by
    ext t j
    simp only [selectedMatrix, Matrix.submatrix, id]
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ t <;> refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Matrix.of_apply, pivots₀,
        show ¬((Fin.last gp.m : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m) from by simp [Fin.last],
        dif_neg, not_false_eq_true, Q₀, Matrix.transpose_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
        A, GlobalParams.a_p, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last, L4sel,
        QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix,
        QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.sb_rr]
    · intro j'
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply, pivots₀,
        show ¬((Fin.last gp.m : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m) from by simp [Fin.last],
        dif_neg, not_false_eq_true, Q₀, Matrix.transpose_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
        A, GlobalParams.a_p,
        show (j'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 j' from rfl,
        show ((Fin.castAdd 1 j').val < gp.m) from j'.isLt,
        dif_pos, Fin.castLT, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last, finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd,
        L4sel, QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix,
        Matrix.transpose_apply, QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.sb_lr]
      simp only [Fin.val_castAdd]
    · intro t'
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply,
        show (t'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 t' from rfl,
        pivots₀, show ((Fin.castAdd 1 t').val < gp.m) from t'.isLt, dif_pos,
        Q₀, Matrix.transpose_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, A, GlobalParams.a_pq,
        show ¬((Fin.last gp.m : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m) from by simp [Fin.last],
        dif_neg, not_false_eq_true, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last,
        finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd, L4sel,
        QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix,
        Matrix.transpose_apply, QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.sb_rl]
    · intro t' j'
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply,
        show (t'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 t' from rfl,
        show (j'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 j' from rfl,
        pivots₀, show ((Fin.castAdd 1 t').val < gp.m) from t'.isLt,
        show ((Fin.castAdd 1 j').val < gp.m) from j'.isLt, dif_pos,
        Q₀, Matrix.transpose_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, A, GlobalParams.a_pq,
        finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd, L4sel,
        QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix,
        Matrix.transpose_apply, QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.sb_ll]
      exact congrArg₂ gp.R_beta (Fin.ext rfl) (Fin.ext rfl)
  have h_inv_eq : (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹ =
      (L4sel)⁻¹.submatrix (⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) (⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) := by
    rw [h_matrix_eq, Matrix.inv_submatrix_equiv]
  have h_gamma_lower : gamma Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst ≥
      Real.sqrt (QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r) :=
    NormBridge.gamma_ge_of_inv_submatrix L4sel⁻¹ _ h_L4 Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst h_inv_eq
  set denom := (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) * ((↑n₀ : ℝ) - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1) with h_denom_def
  have h_bsns_over_r_pos : QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r > 0 :=
    lt_trans (by positivity) h_bsns_large
  rw [gt_iff_lt, ← sub_pos]
  have h1 : gamma Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst / Real.sqrt denom
      - B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e ≥
      Real.sqrt (QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r) /
        Real.sqrt denom
      - B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e := by
    apply sub_le_sub_right
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_gamma_lower (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  suffices h2 : Real.sqrt (QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r) /
      Real.sqrt denom
      > B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e by linarith
  rw [← Real.sqrt_div (le_of_lt h_bsns_over_r_pos)]
  have hBke_nonneg : B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e ≥ 0 := by positivity
  rw [show B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e =
      Real.sqrt ((B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2) from
    (Real.sqrt_sq hBke_nonneg).symm]
  apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ h_denom_pos]
  linarith [h_bsns_large]

variable {n k : ℕ}

def AMatrix (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  Q.transpose

def columnA (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (i : Fin n) : Fin k → ℝ :=
  (AMatrix Q).col i

def colToEuclidean {k : ℕ} (v : Fin k → ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) :=
  (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin k → ℝ)).symm v

def prefixSpan (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (S : List (Fin n)) :
    Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :=
  Submodule.span ℝ {colToEuclidean (columnA Q s) | s ∈ S}

def orthogonalProjector (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (S : List (Fin n)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) :=
  if _h : S = [] then
    0
  else
    let V := prefixSpan Q S
    have : V.HasOrthogonalProjection := by
      infer_instance
    V.subtype.comp (V.orthogonalProjection : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →ₗ[ℝ] V)

def residualScore (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (i : Fin n) (S : List (Fin n)) : ℝ :=
  let a_i := colToEuclidean (columnA Q i)
  let P_S := orthogonalProjector Q S
  let residual := a_i - P_S a_i
  ‖residual‖ ^ 2

def pivotPrefix (pivots : Fin k → Fin n) : ℕ → List (Fin n)
  | 0 => []
  | t+1 =>
    if h : t < k then
      pivotPrefix pivots t ++ [pivots ⟨t, h⟩]
    else
      pivotPrefix pivots t

def IsQRCPPivotSequence (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (pivots : Fin k → Fin n) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : Fin k),
    let S_t := pivotPrefix pivots t.val
    ¬(pivots t ∈ S_t) ∧
    ∀ (i : Fin n), ¬(i ∈ S_t) →
      residualScore Q i S_t ≤ residualScore Q (pivots t) S_t ∧
      (residualScore Q i S_t = residualScore Q (pivots t) S_t → (pivots t).val ≤ i.val)

def selectedMatrix (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (pivots : Fin k → Fin n) :
    Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ :=
  Matrix.submatrix Q pivots id

noncomputable def gamma (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (pivots : Fin k → Fin n)
    [DecidableEq (Fin k)] (_hNonsingular : Invertible (selectedMatrix Q pivots)) : ℝ :=
  ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM.toFun (selectedMatrix Q pivots)⁻¹)‖

def mu (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (n / k : ℝ) * ⨆ (i : Fin n), ∑ (j : Fin k), (Q i j) ^ 2

end QRCPDefinitions

noncomputable def s (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (1 - p.epsilon ^ 2)

noncomputable def d_m (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  p.d ⟨p.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos p.hm⟩

noncomputable def r (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  let tau_0 := 1 / 16
  tau_0 * p.d_m ^ 2

noncomputable def beta : ℝ := 1 / 2
noncomputable def gamma_0 : ℝ := 1 / 4
noncomputable def tau_0 : ℝ := 1 / 16
noncomputable def delta_res : ℝ := 1 / 2

noncomputable def R_beta (p : GlobalParams) : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ :=
  fun t q =>
    if t = q then p.d t
    else if t.1 < q.1 then
      -beta * p.sigma t * p.sigma q * p.s * p.d t
    else 0

noncomputable def z (p : GlobalParams) : Fin p.m → ℝ :=
  fun t =>
    if t.1 < p.m - 1 then
      gamma_0 * p.sigma t * p.s * p.d t
    else
      gamma_0 * p.sigma t * Real.sqrt (1 - tau_0) * p.d t

noncomputable def eta_p (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt tau_0 * p.d_m

noncomputable def kappa_z : ℝ := 1 + (3 / 5) ^ 2 + (4 / 5) ^ 2

noncomputable def kappa_eta : ℝ := 1 + (7 / 15) ^ 2 + (9 / 10) ^ 2

noncomputable def M_rem (p : GlobalParams) : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ :=
  (1 : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ) - p.R_beta * p.R_beta.transpose
    - kappa_z • Matrix.vecMulVec p.z p.z

noncomputable def a_pq (p : GlobalParams) (q : Fin p.m) : Fin (p.m + 1) → ℝ :=
  fun i =>
    if h : i.1 < p.m then p.R_beta (Fin.castLT i h) q
    else 0

noncomputable def a_p (p : GlobalParams) : Fin (p.m + 1) → ℝ :=
  fun i =>
    if h : i.1 < p.m then p.z (Fin.castLT i h)
    else p.eta_p

noncomputable def a_cross (p : GlobalParams) (idx : Fin 2) : Fin (p.m + 1) → ℝ :=
  let a := ![3 / 5, 4 / 5]
  let b := ![7 / 15, 9 / 10]
  fun i =>
    if h : i.1 < p.m then a idx * p.z (Fin.castLT i h)
    else -b idx * p.eta_p

noncomputable def R_plus (p : GlobalParams) :
    Matrix (Fin (p.m + 1)) (Fin (p.m + 1)) ℝ :=
  fun i j =>
    if h_i : i.1 < p.m then
      if h_j : j.1 < p.m then
        p.R_beta (Fin.castLT i h_i) (Fin.castLT j h_j)
      else
        p.z (Fin.castLT i h_i)
    else
      if _ : j.1 < p.m then 0
      else p.eta_p

end GlobalParams

structure Decomposition (p : GlobalParams) where
  H : ℕ
  W : Fin H → ℝ
  u : Fin H → (Fin p.m → ℝ)
  hW_pos : ∀ h, W h > 0
  hunit : ∀ h, ∑ i : Fin p.m, u h i ^ 2 = 1
  hdecomp : ∀ i j : Fin p.m,
    p.M_rem i j = ∑ h : Fin H, W h * u h i * u h j
  hW_bound : ∀ h, W h < p.d_m ^ 2

structure ResidualParams (p : GlobalParams) (d : Decomposition p) where
  J : ℕ
  theta : Fin J → ℝ
  htheta_pos : ∀ j, theta j > 0
  htheta_lt_cres : ∀ j, theta j < p.r / 2
  hmu_res_pos : 1 - GlobalParams.kappa_eta * p.r > 0
  hsum_theta : ∑ j : Fin J, theta j = 1 - GlobalParams.kappa_eta * p.r

open GlobalParams

noncomputable def A (p : GlobalParams)
    (d : Decomposition p)
    (rp : ResidualParams p d)
    : Matrix (Fin (p.m + 1)) (ColIndex p.m d.H rp.J) ℝ :=
  fun i idx => match idx with
    | ColIndex.selected q =>
        p.a_pq q i
    | ColIndex.finalSelected =>
        p.a_p i
    | ColIndex.cross idx =>
        p.a_cross idx i
    | ColIndex.frame h =>
        if h' : i.1 < p.m then
          Real.sqrt (d.W h) * d.u h (Fin.castLT i h')
        else 0
    | ColIndex.residual j =>
        if _ : i.1 < p.m then 0
        else Real.sqrt (rp.theta j)

noncomputable def Q (p : GlobalParams)
    (d : Decomposition p)
    (rp : ResidualParams p d)
    : Matrix (ColIndex p.m d.H rp.J) (Fin (p.m + 1)) ℝ :=
  (A p d rp).transpose

section Definitions

variable {m : ℕ}
  [Fintype (Fin m)] [Fintype (Fin 1)]
  [Fintype (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)]
  [DecidableEq (Fin m)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))]
  [DecidableEq (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)]

def selectedBlock (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ) (eta_p : ℝ) :
    Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks
    R_beta
    (fun i _ => z i)
    (fun _ _ => 0)
    (fun _ _ => eta_p)

noncomputable def backSubstVector (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ) (_h : Invertible R_beta) : Fin m ⊕ Fin 1 → ℝ
  | Sum.inl i => (-(R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z) i)
  | Sum.inr _ => 1

noncomputable def backSubstNormSq (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ) (_ : Invertible R_beta) : ℝ :=
  ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z)‖ ^ 2

def selectedMatrix (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ) (eta_p : ℝ) :
    Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ :=
  (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)ᵀ

theorem sb_ll (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (z : Fin m → ℝ) (eta_p : ℝ) (i j : Fin m) :
    selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) = R_beta i j := rfl

theorem sb_lr (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (z : Fin m → ℝ) (eta_p : ℝ) (i : Fin m)
    (j : Fin 1) :
    selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) = z i := rfl

theorem sb_rl (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (z : Fin m → ℝ) (eta_p : ℝ) (i : Fin 1)
    (j : Fin m) :
    selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = 0 := rfl

theorem sb_rr (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (z : Fin m → ℝ) (eta_p : ℝ) (i j : Fin 1) :
    selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j) = eta_p := rfl

theorem sb_eq (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (z : Fin m → ℝ) (eta_p : ℝ) :
    selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p =
      Matrix.fromBlocks R_beta (Matrix.of fun i (_ : Fin 1) => z i) 0
        (Matrix.of fun (_ : Fin 1) (_ : Fin 1) => eta_p) := by
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;> simp [sb_ll, sb_lr, sb_rl, sb_rr]

end Definitions

section SingularValueBound

variable {m : ℕ}
  [Fintype (Fin m)] [Fintype (Fin 1)]
  [Fintype (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)]
  [DecidableEq (Fin m)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))]
  [DecidableEq (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)]

omit [Fintype (Fin 1)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))] [DecidableEq (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)] in
theorem selectedBlock_mul_specialVector
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta) :
    selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p *ᵥ backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv =
      fun i => match i with
        | Sum.inl _ => 0
        | Sum.inr _ => eta_p := by
  have hinst : @Finset.univ (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) _
              = @Finset.univ _ (instFintypeSum (Fin m) (Fin 1)) := by
    congr 1; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  funext i
  rcases i with j | j
  · change (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p *ᵥ backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv) (Sum.inl j) = 0
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hinst]
    rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp only [sb_ll, sb_lr, backSubstVector]
    simp only [mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Fin.sum_univ_one, mul_one]
    have : (∑ a₁, R_beta j a₁ * (R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z) a₁) = z j :=
      show (R_beta *ᵥ (R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z)) j = z j by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    linarith
  · change (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p *ᵥ backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv) (Sum.inr j) = eta_p
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hinst]
    rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp [sb_rl, sb_rr, backSubstVector]

omit [Fintype (Fin 1)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))] [DecidableEq (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)] in
theorem R_plus_mul_v_norm_sq
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r = eta_p ^ 2)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta) :
    ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm
      (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p *ᵥ backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv)‖ ^ 2 = r := by
  rw [selectedBlock_mul_specialVector R_beta z eta_p h_inv]
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  have hofLp : ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm
                  (fun i : Fin m ⊕ Fin 1 => match i with
                    | Sum.inl _ => (0:ℝ)
                    | Sum.inr _ => eta_p)).ofLp =
                fun i : Fin m ⊕ Fin 1 => match i with
                  | Sum.inl _ => (0:ℝ)
                  | Sum.inr _ => eta_p := rfl
  rw [hofLp]
  have hinst : @Finset.univ (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) _
              = @Finset.univ _ (instFintypeSum (Fin m) (Fin 1)) := by
    congr 1; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hinst, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp [hr, sq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]

omit [Fintype (Fin 1)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))] [DecidableEq (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)] in
theorem specialVector_norm_sq
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta) :
    ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm
      (backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv)‖ ^ 2 =
    1 + backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv := by
  unfold backSubstNormSq
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  have hofLp_v : ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm
                    (backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv)).ofLp =
                  backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv := rfl
  have hofLp_u : ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z)).ofLp =
                  R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z := rfl
  rw [hofLp_v, hofLp_u]
  have hinst : @Finset.univ (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) _
              = @Finset.univ _ (instFintypeSum (Fin m) (Fin 1)) := by
    congr 1; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hinst, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [backSubstVector, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, neg_sq]
  rw [add_comm]
  congr 1
  simp

omit [Fintype (Fin 1)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))] in
theorem singular_value_bound
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r = eta_p ^ 2)
    (hr_pos : r > 0)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta)
    (h_inv_block : Invertible (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)) :
    ‖(selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖ ^ 2 ≥
    (1 + backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv) / r := by
  set R_plus := selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p with hR_plus_def
  set v := backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv with hv_def
  have h_inv_cancel : R_plus⁻¹ *ᵥ (R_plus *ᵥ v) = v := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.inv_mul_of_invertible, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have h_op :
      ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm (R_plus⁻¹ *ᵥ (R_plus *ᵥ v))‖
        ≤ ‖R_plus⁻¹‖ * ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm (R_plus *ᵥ v)‖ :=
    Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec R_plus⁻¹
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm (R_plus *ᵥ v))
  rw [h_inv_cancel] at h_op
  have h_v_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm v‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have h_op_sq :
      ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm v‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (‖R_plus⁻¹‖ * ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm (R_plus *ᵥ v)‖) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ h_v_nonneg h_op 2
  rw [mul_pow] at h_op_sq
  rw [R_plus_mul_v_norm_sq R_beta z eta_p r hr h_inv,
      specialVector_norm_sq R_beta z h_inv] at h_op_sq
  rw [ge_iff_le, div_le_iff₀ hr_pos]
  exact h_op_sq

end SingularValueBound

section InverseNormBound

variable {m : ℕ}
  [Fintype (Fin m)] [Fintype (Fin 1)]
  [Fintype (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)]
  [DecidableEq (Fin m)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))]

omit [Fintype (Fin 1)] in
theorem norm_transpose_eq_norm
    {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    ‖Aᵀ‖ = ‖A‖ := by
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose A

omit [Fintype (Fin 1)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))] in
theorem selectedMatrix_inv_norm_eq
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (_ : Invertible R_beta) :
    ‖(selectedMatrix R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖ = ‖(selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖ := by
  change ‖((selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)ᵀ)⁻¹‖ = ‖(selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖
  rw [← Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
  exact norm_transpose_eq_norm _

omit [Fintype (Fin 1)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))] in
theorem inverse_norm_sq_lower_bound
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r = eta_p ^ 2)
    (hr_pos : r > 0)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta)
    (h_inv_block : Invertible (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)) :
    ‖(selectedMatrix R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖ ^ 2 ≥
    (1 + backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv) / r := by
  rw [selectedMatrix_inv_norm_eq R_beta z eta_p h_inv]
  exact singular_value_bound R_beta z eta_p r hr hr_pos h_inv h_inv_block

omit [Fintype (Fin 1)] [DecidableEq (Fin (m + 1))] in
theorem lemma4_selected_block_pressure
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r = eta_p ^ 2)
    (hr_pos : r > 0)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta)
    (h_inv_block : Invertible (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)) :
    ‖(selectedMatrix R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖ ≥
    Real.sqrt (backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv / r) := by
  rw [selectedMatrix_inv_norm_eq R_beta z eta_p h_inv]
  have h_Z_nn : 0 ≤ backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv := by unfold backSubstNormSq; positivity
  have h_sq := inverse_norm_sq_lower_bound R_beta z eta_p r hr hr_pos h_inv h_inv_block
  rw [selectedMatrix_inv_norm_eq R_beta z eta_p h_inv] at h_sq
  rw [ge_iff_le, ← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  linarith [div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith : backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv ≤
    1 + backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv) hr_pos.le, h_sq]

end InverseNormBound

private lemma toEuclideanCLM_ofLp' {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := n)) A v).ofLp = A *ᵥ v.ofLp := by
  show (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v).ofLp = _
  show ((toLpLin (R := ℝ) 2 2 A) v).ofLp = _
  rw [ofLp_toLpLin]; rfl

private lemma ofLp_injective' (p : ENNReal) {V : Type*} {a b : WithLp p V}
    (h : a.ofLp = b.ofLp) : a = b := by
  have := congrArg (WithLp.toLp p) h
  rwa [WithLp.toLp_ofLp, WithLp.toLp_ofLp] at this

private lemma clm_norm_submatrix_finSumFinEquiv (m : ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ) :
    ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin (m + 1)))
      (M.submatrix (⇑(finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)).symm)
        (⇑(finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)).symm))‖ =
    ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)) M‖ := by
  set e := finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)
  set f' := (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin (m + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ))
    (M.submatrix (⇑e.symm) (⇑e.symm))
  set f := (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) (𝕜 := ℝ)) M
  set φ := LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ e.symm
  have key : f' = (φ.symm.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap).comp
      (f.comp (φ.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap)) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext; intro v
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap,
               LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearIsometry]
    show f' v = φ.symm (f (φ v))
    apply ofLp_injective' 2
    rw [toEuclideanCLM_ofLp' (M.submatrix (⇑e.symm) (⇑e.symm)) v]
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_symm, show e.symm.symm = e from e.symm_symm]
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_apply]
    ext i; simp only [Equiv.piCongrLeft'_apply]
    rw [toEuclideanCLM_ofLp' M (φ v)]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    have phi_comp : ∀ j', (φ v).ofLp j' = v.ofLp (e j') := by
      intro j'
      show (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ e.symm v).ofLp j' = _
      rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_apply]
      simp [Equiv.piCongrLeft'_apply]
    simp_rw [phi_comp, Matrix.submatrix, ← Equiv.sum_comp e.symm]
    simp [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [key, LinearIsometry.norm_toContinuousLinearMap_comp]
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_linearIsometryEquiv f φ

open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator in
lemma gamma_ge_of_inv_submatrix {m : ℕ}
    (M : Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hM : ‖M‖ ≥ C)
    {n₀ : ℕ} (Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
    (pivots₀ : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n₀)
    (hInv : Invertible (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀))
    (h_inv_eq : (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹ =
      M.submatrix (⇑(finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)).symm)
        (⇑(finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)).symm)) :
    gamma Q₀ pivots₀ hInv ≥ C := by
  show ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM.toFun (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹‖ ≥ C
  have h_rfl : (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM.toFun (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹ :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) =
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin (m + 1)))
        (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹ := rfl
  rw [h_rfl, h_inv_eq, clm_norm_submatrix_finSumFinEquiv]
  rwa [Matrix.l2_opNorm_toEuclideanCLM]

theorem parseval_QTQ_eq_one
    (gp : GlobalParams)
    (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J))) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    Q₀.transpose * Q₀ = 1 := by
  intro eidx Q₀
  set AA := A gp decomp resP with hAA
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  change ∑ x, AA i (eidx.symm x) * AA j (eidx.symm x) = _
  rw [show ∑ x, AA i (eidx.symm x) * AA j (eidx.symm x)
      = ∑ c : ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J, AA i c * AA j c
    from Equiv.sum_comp eidx.symm (fun c => AA i c * AA j c)]
  rw [ColIndex.sum_eq]
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
  · 
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j

inductive ColIndex (m H J : ℕ)

structure GlobalParams where
  H_star : ℝ
  hH_star : H_star > 1
  B : ℝ
  hB : B > 0
  e : ℝ
  he : e ≥ 0
  K : ℕ
  hK : K ≥ 1
  eta : ℝ
  heta_pos : eta > 0
  heta_bound : Real.exp (2 * eta) < H_star
  m : ℕ
  hm : m > 0
  hk : m + 1 ≥ K
  alpha : ℝ
  halpha : alpha > 0
  sigma : Fin m → ℝ
  hsigma : ∀ t, sigma t = 1 ∨ sigma t = -1

namespace GlobalParams

noncomputable def epsilon (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-p.eta / (p.m + 1))

noncomputable def d (p : GlobalParams) (t : Fin p.m) : ℝ :=
  p.alpha * p.epsilon ^ t.1

noncomputable def s (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (1 - p.epsilon ^ 2)

noncomputable def d_m (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  p.d ⟨p.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos p.hm⟩

noncomputable def r (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  let tau_0 := 1 / 16
  tau_0 * p.d_m ^ 2

noncomputable def beta : ℝ := 1 / 2
noncomputable def gamma_0 : ℝ := 1 / 4
noncomputable def tau_0 : ℝ := 1 / 16
noncomputable def delta_res : ℝ := 1 / 2

noncomputable def R_beta (p : GlobalParams) : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ :=
  fun t q =>
    if t = q then p.d t
    else if t.1 < q.1 then
      -beta * p.sigma t * p.sigma q * p.s * p.d t
    else 0

noncomputable def z (p : GlobalParams) : Fin p.m → ℝ :=
  fun t =>
    if t.1 < p.m - 1 then
      gamma_0 * p.sigma t * p.s * p.d t
    else
      gamma_0 * p.sigma t * Real.sqrt (1 - tau_0) * p.d t

noncomputable def eta_p (p : GlobalParams) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt tau_0 * p.d_m

noncomputable def kappa_z : ℝ := 1 + (3 / 5) ^ 2 + (4 / 5) ^ 2

noncomputable def kappa_eta : ℝ := 1 + (7 / 15) ^ 2 + (9 / 10) ^ 2

noncomputable def M_rem (p : GlobalParams) : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ :=
  (1 : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ) - p.R_beta * p.R_beta.transpose
    - kappa_z • Matrix.vecMulVec p.z p.z

noncomputable def a_pq (p : GlobalParams) (q : Fin p.m) : Fin (p.m + 1) → ℝ :=
  fun i =>
    if h : i.1 < p.m then p.R_beta (Fin.castLT i h) q
    else 0

noncomputable def a_p (p : GlobalParams) : Fin (p.m + 1) → ℝ :=
  fun i =>
    if h : i.1 < p.m then p.z (Fin.castLT i h)
    else p.eta_p

noncomputable def a_cross (p : GlobalParams) (idx : Fin 2) : Fin (p.m + 1) → ℝ :=
  let a := ![3 / 5, 4 / 5]
  let b := ![7 / 15, 9 / 10]
  fun i =>
    if h : i.1 < p.m then a idx * p.z (Fin.castLT i h)
    else -b idx * p.eta_p

noncomputable def R_plus (p : GlobalParams) :
    Matrix (Fin (p.m + 1)) (Fin (p.m + 1)) ℝ :=
  fun i j =>
    if h_i : i.1 < p.m then
      if h_j : j.1 < p.m then
        p.R_beta (Fin.castLT i h_i) (Fin.castLT j h_j)
      else
        p.z (Fin.castLT i h_i)
    else
      if _ : j.1 < p.m then 0
      else p.eta_p

end GlobalParams

structure Decomposition (p : GlobalParams) where
  H : ℕ
  W : Fin H → ℝ
  u : Fin H → (Fin p.m → ℝ)
  hW_pos : ∀ h, W h > 0
  hunit : ∀ h, ∑ i : Fin p.m, u h i ^ 2 = 1
  hdecomp : ∀ i j : Fin p.m,
    p.M_rem i j = ∑ h : Fin H, W h * u h i * u h j
  hW_bound : ∀ h, W h < p.d_m ^ 2

structure ResidualParams (p : GlobalParams) (d : Decomposition p) where
  J : ℕ
  theta : Fin J → ℝ
  htheta_pos : ∀ j, theta j > 0
  htheta_lt_cres : ∀ j, theta j < p.r / 2
  hmu_res_pos : 1 - GlobalParams.kappa_eta * p.r > 0
  hsum_theta : ∑ j : Fin J, theta j = 1 - GlobalParams.kappa_eta * p.r

open GlobalParams

noncomputable def A (p : GlobalParams)
    (d : Decomposition p)
    (rp : ResidualParams p d)
    : Matrix (Fin (p.m + 1)) (ColIndex p.m d.H rp.J) ℝ :=
  fun i idx => match idx with
    | ColIndex.selected q =>
        p.a_pq q i
    | ColIndex.finalSelected =>
        p.a_p i
    | ColIndex.cross idx =>
        p.a_cross idx i
    | ColIndex.frame h =>
        if h' : i.1 < p.m then
          Real.sqrt (d.W h) * d.u h (Fin.castLT i h')
        else 0
    | ColIndex.residual j =>
        if _ : i.1 < p.m then 0
        else Real.sqrt (rp.theta j)

noncomputable def Q (p : GlobalParams)
    (d : Decomposition p)
    (rp : ResidualParams p d)
    : Matrix (ColIndex p.m d.H rp.J) (Fin (p.m + 1)) ℝ :=
  (A p d rp).transpose

def colIndexEquiv (m H J : ℕ) :
    ColIndex m H J ≃ (Fin m) ⊕ (Unit) ⊕ (Fin 2) ⊕ (Fin H) ⊕ (Fin J) where
  toFun c := match c with
    | .selected q => .inl q
    | .finalSelected => .inr (.inl ())
    | .cross i => .inr (.inr (.inl i))
    | .frame h => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl h)))
    | .residual j => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr j)))
  invFun s := match s with
    | .inl q => .selected q
    | .inr (.inl ()) => .finalSelected
    | .inr (.inr (.inl i)) => .cross i
    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl h))) => .frame h
    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr j))) => .residual j
  left_inv c := by cases c <;> rfl
  right_inv s := by rcases s with q | ⟨⟩ | i | h | j <;> rfl

lemma ColIndex.sum_eq {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] {m H J : ℕ}
    (f : ColIndex m H J → α) :
    ∑ c, f c = ∑ q, f (.selected q) + f .finalSelected
      + ∑ i, f (.cross i) + ∑ h, f (.frame h)
      + ∑ j, f (.residual j) := by
  rw [Fintype.sum_equiv (colIndexEquiv m H J) f
    (fun s => f ((colIndexEquiv m H J).symm s))
    (fun c => by simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply])]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, colIndexEquiv, Equiv.symm]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_unique]
  abel

lemma colIndex_card (m H J : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (ColIndex m H J) = m + 1 + 2 + H + J := by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (colIndexEquiv m H J)]
  simp [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]; omega

    ∀ h : Fin gp.m, h_sym.eigenvalues h ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h_psd : ((1 : Matrix _ _ ℝ) - gp.M_rem).PosSemidef := by
    have h_eq : (1 : Matrix _ _ ℝ) - gp.M_rem =
        gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose +
        GlobalParams.kappa_z • Matrix.vecMulVec gp.z gp.z := by
      simp only [GlobalParams.M_rem]; ext i j
      simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply,

      rw [show gp.R_beta.transpose = gp.R_beta.conjTranspose from by ext i j; simp]
      exact Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose gp.R_beta
    exact hRRT.add (by
      apply Matrix.PosSemidef.smul _ (by unfold GlobalParams.kappa_z; norm_num)
      rw [show Matrix.vecMulVec gp.z gp.z = Matrix.vecMulVec gp.z (star gp.z)

      exact Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star gp.z)
  set v := (h_sym.eigenvectorBasis h).ofLp with hv_def
  have h_quad : 0 ≤ star v ⬝ᵥ ((1 - gp.M_rem) *ᵥ v) :=
    h_psd.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg v
  rw [show star v = v from funext (fun i => star_trivial (r := v i)),
      show (1 - gp.M_rem) *ᵥ v = v - gp.M_rem *ᵥ v from by
        simp [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec],
      dotProduct_sub, h_sym.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis h, dotProduct_smul] at h_quad
  have h_vv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    have h_norm := EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq (h_sym.eigenvectorBasis h)
    rw [h_sym.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 h, one_pow] at h_norm
    simp only [dotProduct, sq] at h_norm ⊢; linarith
  rw [h_vv, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h_quad; linarith

    congr 1; push_cast; field_simp
  rw [h_eps_sq]
  have harg : -(2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)) = -2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1) := by ring
  have key := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)))
  rw [harg] at key; linarith

lemma d_le_alpha (i : Fin p.m) : p.d i ≤ p.alpha := by
  unfold d
  have : p.alpha * p.epsilon ^ i.val ≤ p.alpha * 1 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ (le_of_lt p.epsilon_pos') p.epsilon_le_one) (le_of_lt p.halpha)
  linarith

lemma d_pos' (i : Fin p.m) : p.d i > 0 := by
  unfold d; exact mul_pos p.halpha (pow_pos p.epsilon_pos' _)

lemma sigma_sq (i : Fin p.m) : p.sigma i ^ 2 = 1 := by
  cases p.hsigma i with
  | inl h => rw [h]; ring
  | inr h => rw [h]; ring

lemma d_sq_le (i : Fin p.m) : p.d i ^ 2 ≤ p.alpha ^ 2 :=
  sq_le_sq' (by linarith [p.d_pos' i, p.d_le_alpha i]) (p.d_le_alpha i)

lemma m_sub_one_mul_s_sq_le : (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 ≤ 2 * p.eta := by
  have hs := p.s_sq_le
  have hm1_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ↑p.m - 1 := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ↑p.m := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr p.hm; linarith
  calc (↑p.m - 1 : ℝ) * p.s ^ 2
      ≤ (↑p.m - 1) * (2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hm1_nn
    _ ≤ (↑p.m + 1) * (2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith)
        exact div_nonneg (by linarith [p.heta_pos]) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * p.eta := by field_simp

private lemma R_off_diag_sq (i j : Fin p.m) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    p.R_beta i j * p.R_beta i j ≤ p.s ^ 2 / 4 * p.alpha ^ 2 := by
  have hR : p.R_beta i j = if i = j then p.d i
      else if i.val < j.val then -beta * p.sigma i * p.sigma j * p.s * p.d i
      else 0 := rfl
  rw [hR, if_neg hij]
  split_ifs with h2
  · have hsi := p.sigma_sq i; have hsj := p.sigma_sq j
    have calc1 : -beta * p.sigma i * p.sigma j * p.s * p.d i *
      (-beta * p.sigma i * p.sigma j * p.s * p.d i) =
      (1/4) * (p.sigma i ^ 2) * (p.sigma j ^ 2) * p.s ^ 2 * p.d i ^ 2 := by
      unfold beta; ring
    rw [calc1, hsi, hsj]
    nlinarith [p.d_sq_le i, sq_nonneg p.s]
  · simp only [zero_mul]; positivity

private lemma R_diag_sq (i : Fin p.m) :
    p.R_beta i i * p.R_beta i i ≤ p.alpha ^ 2 := by
  have : p.R_beta i i = p.d i := by unfold R_beta; simp
  rw [this]; linarith [p.d_sq_le i, sq_nonneg (p.d i)]

private lemma row_sq_sum_le (i : Fin p.m) :
    ∑ j : Fin p.m, p.R_beta i j * p.R_beta i j ≤
    p.alpha ^ 2 + (↑p.m - 1) * (p.s ^ 2 / 4 * p.alpha ^ 2) := by
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  apply add_le_add
  · exact p.R_diag_sq i
  · have h_card : (Finset.univ.erase i).card = p.m - 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]; simp [Fintype.card_fin]
    calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, p.R_beta i j * p.R_beta i j
        ≤ (Finset.univ.erase i).card • (p.s ^ 2 / 4 * p.alpha ^ 2) :=
          Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ (fun j hj => p.R_off_diag_sq i j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm)
      _ = ↑(Finset.univ.erase i).card * (p.s ^ 2 / 4 * p.alpha ^ 2) := nsmul_eq_mul _ _
      _ = (↑p.m - 1) * (p.s ^ 2 / 4 * p.alpha ^ 2) := by
          rw [h_card, Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ p.m from p.hm)]
          simp

lemma R_beta_trace_le :
    (p.R_beta * p.R_beta.transpose).trace ≤ ↑p.m * p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + p.eta / 2) := by
  unfold trace diag
  simp only [mul_apply, transpose_apply]
  have h_row : ∀ i : Fin p.m,
      ∑ j : Fin p.m, p.R_beta i j * p.R_beta i j ≤
      p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 / 4) := by
    intro i
    have := p.row_sq_sum_le i
    linarith
  calc ∑ i : Fin p.m, ∑ j : Fin p.m, p.R_beta i j * p.R_beta i j
      ≤ ∑ _i : Fin p.m, (p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 / 4)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_row i)
    _ = ↑p.m * (p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 / 4)) := by
        simp [Finset.sum_const, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ ↑p.m * (p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + p.eta / 2)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        linarith [p.m_sub_one_mul_s_sq_le]
    _ = ↑p.m * p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + p.eta / 2) := by ring

lemma kz_z_norm_sq_le :
    kappa_z * (p.z ⬝ᵥ p.z) ≤ p.alpha ^ 2 * (p.eta / 4 + 15 / 128) := by
  have hkz : kappa_z = 2 := by unfold kappa_z; norm_num
  rw [hkz]
  unfold dotProduct
  have hz_entry : ∀ i : Fin p.m, p.z i * p.z i ≤
      if i.val < p.m - 1 then p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2
      else 15 / 256 * p.alpha ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    unfold z gamma_0 tau_0
    split_ifs with hi
    · have hsi := p.sigma_sq i
      have hdi := p.d_sq_le i
      have hs0 := p.s_nonneg
      have : (1 : ℝ) / 4 * p.sigma i * p.s * p.d i * (1 / 4 * p.sigma i * p.s * p.d i) =
          1 / 16 * (p.sigma i ^ 2) * p.s ^ 2 * p.d i ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this, hsi]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg p.s]
    · have hsi := p.sigma_sq i
      have hdi := p.d_sq_le i
      have h_sqrt : Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) = Real.sqrt (15 / 16) := by norm_num
      have h_sq : Real.sqrt (15 / 16) ^ 2 = 15 / 16 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt]; norm_num
      have : (1 : ℝ) / 4 * p.sigma i * Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) * p.d i *
          (1 / 4 * p.sigma i * Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) * p.d i) =
          1 / 16 * (p.sigma i ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) ^ 2) * p.d i ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this, hsi, h_sqrt, h_sq]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.d i)]
  have h_sum : ∑ i : Fin p.m, p.z i * p.z i ≤
      15 / 256 * p.alpha ^ 2 + (↑p.m - 1) * (p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2) := by
    let last : Fin p.m := ⟨p.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos p.hm⟩
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ last)]
    apply add_le_add
    · have hlast : ¬ (last.val < p.m - 1) := by simp [last]
      have := hz_entry last
      rw [if_neg hlast] at this
      exact this
    · have h_card : (Finset.univ.erase last).card = p.m - 1 := by
        rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ last)]; simp [Fintype.card_fin]
      calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase last, p.z j * p.z j
          ≤ (Finset.univ.erase last).card • (p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul
            intro j hj
            have hj_ne : j ≠ last := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj
            have hj_lt : j.val < p.m - 1 := by
              have hj_lt_m := j.isLt
              have : j.val ≠ p.m - 1 := by
                intro heq
                exact hj_ne (Fin.ext heq)
              omega
            have := hz_entry j
            rw [if_pos hj_lt] at this
            exact this
        _ = ↑(Finset.univ.erase last).card * (p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2) := nsmul_eq_mul _ _
        _ = (↑p.m - 1) * (p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2) := by
            rw [h_card, Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ p.m from p.hm)]; simp
  have h_s_bound : (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 / 8 ≤ p.eta / 4 := by linarith [p.m_sub_one_mul_s_sq_le]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg p.s, sq_nonneg p.alpha]
